validation: Root reports targeted exit 0; final log inspected. Reviewer ran no builds and changed no source.

checks.checkpoint_frame: Uses exact checkpoint_eq with admitted existing sender. Sender/protected alias handled directly: debited account changes only balance and nonce, retaining installed code and persistent storage. Distinct sender lookup unchanged. Full Admission is an explicit stronger-than-needed premise; frame proof uses its sender field only.
checks.settled_frame: Uses exact settledWorld refund credit, conditional beneficiary credit and actual cleanup. Both credits preserve code/storage even when recipient aliases protected address. Existing nonempty code is transported through both credits, then excludes dead-account cleanup; explicit selfDestructSet nonmembership excludes destructive cleanup. No arithmetic gas, refund or price inequality is required for this frame claim.
checks.settled_codeAt_frame: Extracts actual installed account and exact runtime from CodeAt and proves both runtime codes nonempty by kernel decision, then applies settled_frame.
checks.provisional_cases: Inverts exact Context.provisional recipient branch and Except result. Creation and message requests use same checkpoint/original world, substate, fuel, effective price, value, payload, sender/origin, depth and permission as the raw Lambda/Theta call. All four projected fields world/gas/substate/status are retained exactly; only target/created/output become existential. False status is preserved without any success requirement.

explicit_premises: checkpoint_frame: TransactionFunding.Admission including actual existing sender, upfront funding, nonce and priority bounds
settled_frame: actual existing protected account with nonempty code and protected address absent from supplied destruction set
settled_codeAt_frame: CodeAt in provisional world and destruction-set exclusion
provisional_cases: actual successful Except projection c.provisional=.ok(world,gas,ss,status), regardless status Bool
scope_limits: These are framing/projection lemmas, not funding conservation or protocol admission extraction.
settled_frame does not itself connect a supplied world/gas/substate to c.result; global consumer must compose actual provisional result and TransactionFunding.result_equation.
No per-call invariant or child postcondition is assumed; no selfdestruct exclusion producer is silently supplied.
Frame preserves persistent storage and existing code/existence, not balances, nonce or transient storage.
